presets.label: Reporter's Current Issues
presets.jql: reporter = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

presets.label: My Current Issues
presets.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

presets.label: MCP - Ask Greg
presets.jql: issuekey ~ "ODI-*" AND issuetype IN (subTaskIssueTypes(), standardIssueTypes(), "Sub-task") AND summary ~ "(AskGreg OR MCP)" OR parent IN (ODI-23066) ORDER BY key DESC, parent ASC, status ASC, rank

presets.label: ODI-Dev WGA Epic
presets.jql: issuekey ~ "ODI-*" AND issuetype IN (subTaskIssueTypes(), standardIssueTypes(), "Sub-task") AND parent IN (ODI-343) AND NOT status IN (closed, resolved) ORDER BY key DESC, parent ASC, status ASC, rank

presets.label: Kronos
presets.jql: parent IN (ODI-22128) AND issuetype IN (subtaskIssueTypes(), standardIssueTypes(), "Sub-task") OR summary ~ "\[Cipher-Kronos\]" AND issuekey ~ "ODI-*" ORDER BY key DESC, parent ASC, status ASC, rank

presets.label: Vendor Scrape
presets.jql: issuekey = ODI-18274 OR parent = ODI-18274 OR (parent = ODI-18274 AND issuetype in (Task, Bug, Story)) OR (issuekey = ODI-3480 AND issuetype in (Task, Bug, Story)) ORDER BY created DESC

presets.label: Nora

presets.label: GAM
presets.jql: parent IN (ODI-22288) AND issuekey ~ "ODI-*" AND issuetype IN (subTaskIssueTypes(), standardIssueTypes(), "Sub-task") OR summary ~ "(Fiber_GCR_Clean_Service_Impact_Automation)"  ORDER BY key DESC, parent ASC, status ASC, rank

presets.label: IP Large Project

presets.label: Monkey Wrench
